versions.changelog:
Initial release of Generate Restaurant Ad Creative Brief

- Enables planning of campaign visuals and creative hooks for restaurant-focused ad promotions.
- Designed for use in paid campaign planning by restaurant owners and food delivery businesses.
- Integrates chat and image generation APIs to create comprehensive creative briefs.
- Includes setup guide and SEO-focused content for discoverability.
- Provides a structured workflow for clarifying goals, drafting, enhancing, and refining campaign briefs.
